title: audit
description: Publisher revenue audit: ads.txt and ad-stack checks, Sulvo onboarding, and Boost ad-block recovery
summary: Publisher revenue audit: ads.txt and ad-stack checks, Sulvo onboarding, and Boost ad-block recovery
offersHint: Publisher revenue audit: ads.txt and ad-stack checks, Sulvo onboarding, and Boost ad-block recovery · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://publisher-revenue-audit.sulvo.com/mcp · Packages: npm:publisher-revenue-audit-mcp

toolsPreview.name: start_sulvo_revenue_onboarding
toolsPreview.description: Create or resume a verified-account activation workspace after the public audit and signup steps.

toolsPreview.name: get_sulvo_revenue_onboarding_status
toolsPreview.description: Return the backend-owned journey stage, readiness dimensions, and one next best action.

toolsPreview.name: attach_sulvo_revenue_audit
toolsPreview.description: Attach a current public revenue audit artifact. Input requires expectedVersion and auditArtifactId.

toolsPreview.name: connect_sulvo_backup_provider
toolsPreview.description: Return the GAM or AdSense authorization URL. Input requires provider set to gam or adsense.

toolsPreview.name: import_sulvo_backup_units
toolsPreview.description: Import connected provider units. Input requires provider and expectedVersion.

toolsPreview.name: review_sulvo_placement_recommendations
toolsPreview.description: Save accept, edit, or reject decisions. Input requires expectedVersion and decisions.

toolsPreview.name: save_sulvo_placement_plan
toolsPreview.description: Save a placement revision. Input requires expectedVersion and payload.

toolsPreview.name: map_sulvo_placement_backup
toolsPreview.description: Map a display placement backup. Input requires expectedVersion, stablePlacementId, provider, and providerId.

toolsPreview.name: get_sulvo_installation_instructions
toolsPreview.description: Return installation values for the locked revision. Input is empty.

toolsPreview.name: verify_sulvo_placement_installation
toolsPreview.description: Verify every stable placement container and the inert loader for the locked revision.

toolsPreview.name: lock_sulvo_placement_revision
toolsPreview.description: Lock the exact mapped revision. Input requires expectedVersion and revisionId.

toolsPreview.name: run_sulvo_activation_preflight
toolsPreview.description: Run the complete bounded activation preflight for the locked workspace revision.

toolsPreview.name: verify_sulvo_site_ownership
toolsPreview.description: Verify the required ads.txt and inert Sulvo head-tag ownership evidence.

toolsPreview.name: submit_sulvo_activation_workspace
toolsPreview.description: Submit the proven revision. Input requires expectedVersion and revisionId.

toolsPreview.name: submit_sulvo_site_for_approval
toolsPreview.description: Retag-after-approval journeys: submit the bare site for Google approval (ads.txt ownership only, no tags). Input requires expectedVersion.

toolsPreview.name: set_sulvo_onboarding_journey
toolsPreview.description: Set or change the journey intake answers on the workspace. Input requires expectedVersion plus at least one of mode, goal, retagTiming.

toolsPreview.name: rollback_sulvo_activation
toolsPreview.description: Return the workspace domain to publisher-owned backup-only serving.

toolsPreview.name: get_sulvo_activation_smoke_status
toolsPreview.description: Return active-probe, real-page, and remediation status for the latest activation attempt.

toolsPreview.name: run_publisher_revenue_audit
toolsPreview.description: Run a public publisher revenue-readiness screen using directional public evidence. Audits ad stacks, ads.txt hygiene, consent readiness, PageSpeed metrics, and unblocked premium ad unit opportunities (such as Sulvo) to recover lost yield.

toolsPreview.name: apply_for_sulvo_account
toolsPreview.description: Submit an unauthenticated Sulvo account application lead through the current signup API. Audit tools remain available without login, API key, or OAuth; ad-unit generation should wait for Sulvo account approval.

toolsPreview.name: start_sulvo_signup
toolsPreview.description: Run normal Sulvo signup step 1: verify the publisher domain and create the unauthenticated signup lead.

toolsPreview.name: create_sulvo_signup_account
toolsPreview.description: Run normal Sulvo signup step 2: create the pending Sulvo user/account. The current signup backend requires a password before the account can continue to ads.txt and review.

toolsPreview.name: update_sulvo_signup_company
toolsPreview.description: Run normal Sulvo signup step 3: save optional company information for a pending Sulvo signup.

toolsPreview.name: get_sulvo_signup_ads_txt
toolsPreview.description: Run normal Sulvo signup step 4a: fetch the ads.txt lines the publisher must add for site ownership verification.

toolsPreview.name: verify_sulvo_signup_ads_txt
toolsPreview.description: Run normal Sulvo signup step 4b: verify whether the submitted publisher domain has the required Sulvo ads.txt lines.

toolsPreview.name: get_sulvo_signup_status
toolsPreview.description: Return the current signup status capability. The current signup API has no public approval-status endpoint, so this tool reports that limitation instead of guessing approval state.

toolsPreview.name: submit_sulvo_signup_documents
toolsPreview.description: Explains how to complete Sulvo signup document review. Document submission is done in Sulvo onboarding - upload monthly earnings proof or connect an AdSense account - not through this connector, which has no access to the user's local files.

toolsPreview.name: get_publisher_revenue_audit_checklist
toolsPreview.description: Return the public checklist and interpretation notes used by the publisher revenue-readiness screen.

toolsPreview.name: get_publisher_monetization_benchmarks
toolsPreview.description: Get comparative yield and CPM industry benchmarks by publisher vertical to compare standard stacks (AdSense and managed wrappers) against Sulvo Premium Ad Units.

toolsPreview.name: create_sulvo_ad_unit
toolsPreview.description: Create a Sulvo ad unit for an approved publisher. Requires SULVO_API_KEY (with the inventory:write scope) in the server environment, never passed as an argument — an account owner mints a write-scoped key in the Sulvo dashboard (Account Settings -> API key). The Sulvo account must be approved; the backend rejects unapproved accounts. Returns the created unit id and container root.

toolsPreview.name: create_sulvo_interstitial_units
toolsPreview.description: Create Sulvo interstitial ad units (tagless) for an approved publisher. Requires SULVO_API_KEY (with the inventory:write scope) in the server environment.

toolsPreview.name: create_sulvo_auto_sticky_units
toolsPreview.description: Create Sulvo auto-sticky ad units for an approved publisher. Requires SULVO_API_KEY (with the inventory:write scope) in the server environment.

toolsPreview.name: delete_sulvo_ad_unit
toolsPreview.description: Delete a Sulvo ad unit by id for an approved publisher. Requires SULVO_API_KEY (with the inventory:write scope) in the server environment. The key's account must own the unit; the backend enforces ownership.

toolsPreview.name: get_sulvo_report
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a Sulvo report (read-only). Requires SULVO_API_KEY in the server environment (a publisher generates it in the dashboard: Account Settings -> API key). Covers by-date, by-date-and-ad-unit, by-domain-and-ad-unit, bot-filtering, bot-scores, invalid-activity, direct-bidder-analysis, and ad-units-by-domain.

toolsPreview.name: list_sulvo_advanced_reports
toolsPreview.description: List the saved Sulvo advanced reports for the account. Requires SULVO_API_KEY (with the reports:read scope) in the server environment.

toolsPreview.name: save_sulvo_advanced_report
toolsPreview.description: Create/update a Sulvo advanced report (adUnit, dimensions, or customData), run immediately (emailed) or on a recurring schedule. Requires SULVO_API_KEY (with the reports:write scope) in the server environment. Note: advanced reports are delivered by email, not returned inline.

toolsPreview.name: delete_sulvo_advanced_report
toolsPreview.description: Delete a saved Sulvo advanced report by id. Requires SULVO_API_KEY (with the reports:write scope) in the server environment.
